fit.title: operating cash flow
fit.reason: Operating revenue, margins, cash conversion and reinvestment drive value; business-specific accounting and financing adjustments remain necessary. Skydance completed its Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition on October 6 and changed its listing from PSKY to SKYD. The June financial statements describe Paramount Skydance before WBD and before the acquisition financing, new Class B equity and warrant rights. Historical EPS, operating growth, cash flows, debt and share counts cannot value the combined company without a matched combined-business and capital-claims bridge. A later publication date alone does not make a predecessor period comparable; each annual/TTM component must cover a compatible post-combination period. Class B warrants were distributed after the acquisition. Outstanding common stock, eligible-holder exclusions, exercise terms and dilution must be reconciled with the new equity and financing; no current fully diluted share count or split ratio is inferred.
